title: Refined AI preferences and on-demand private connection management
steps: Replace exposed credential controls with compact status-only provider cards
Move credential changes to provider-specific modal dialogs created only on demand and scrubbed on close
Separate task routing, daily limits and optional pricing into structured progressive-disclosure sections
Keep credential-only saves independent from pending model/budget/price edits
Verify responsive light/dark UI, keyboard dialog controls, secrets and save isolation
Run full verification, deploy and preserve production inputs
constraints: No existing API-key values returned, masked or revealed
No credential-input elements on the main settings page
Only explicit connection actions change credentials
No provider/model/default changes or production credential changes during testing
Preserve existing task routes and unknown model prices
Preserve CLI workflows and production data
